text: Revenue grew by twelve percent in the quarter, driven by the enterprise segment, the mid-market segment and the international segment. We do not expect this pace to continue, and we will not raise guidance for the full year. Operating expenses rose with headcount, marketing spend and R&D investment. The balance sheet remains strong, and it does not rely on short-term financing. Management believes that the current mix of products, services and recurring revenue provides a durable base for growth.

The report reviews cash flow, working capital and leverage over the past three quarters. We do not see a liquidity risk, and we will not need to draw on the credit facility. Capital expenditure was higher than forecast, and it is not expected to repeat at the same level. The team examined the pricing, the margin and the volume assumptions behind the outlook. In summary, the outlook is balanced, and it does not depend on a single customer or a single product line.
